beats.speaker: spark
lines: It's too dark to see anything.

beats.speaker: spark
lines: You aimed the light at me.
I can only see what the beam touches.

beats.speaker: spark
lines: Three crystals — they were here the whole time.
We just couldn't see them in the dark.

beats.speaker: spark
lines: Same as a streetlight at night.
The street is always there — the light just lets you see it.
